comparison.objective: Center a gasket between flanges and insert four bolts; candidate removes a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Occluded gasket placement and multi-hole bolt alignment/insertion versus dual-blade tool alignment and tang-release extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Gasket flat and centered with all bolts seated versus selected terminal removed without connector damage.
comparison.reason: The gasket task tests assembly alignment and insertion, not retained-contact release.
